summary: No new trust boundary; the change is pure engine arithmetic over values already validated by createHand (every stack a safe integer, stack total <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, hand.ts createHand). Chip conservation: buildPots layers sum to sum(totalContribution) - returned (last pot uncapped, so folded seats' chips above the top live level are not lost), gather credits `back` to the returned seat's stack, payOut sums all award shares, and splitPot distributes base*n + odd == amount exactly. All pot amounts and award sums are bounded by the stack total, so arithmetic stays within safe integers. No award to an ineligible seat: each pot's contenders are showdown entries filtered by pot.eligible, and eligible lists only non-folded seats with put >= level; every level comes from a non-folded seat, so contenders is never empty (no Math.max(-Infinity)/divide-by-zero in splitPot). In foldOut only the winner is non-folded, so there is exactly one level and the winner is eligible. Award `pot` indices come from gathered.pots.map((pot, k)), so they are 0..pots.length-1 and always in range; the UI consumer (src/table/hand-result.ts handResultView) only sums winners by seat and does not index pots. No new dependencies, secrets, logging, randomness, or I/O.
